summary: Find the hall sensor behind the bezel and watch it respond to a magnet.
release_notes: Rebuilt on a renderer that keeps every control reachable at the largest text sizes, and on a keyboard that can type every character this app asks for.
user: Somebody curious about the sensor behind their reader's bezel.
job: Find the hall sensor and watch it respond to a magnet.

data.location: the app's private storage on the reader
data.export: not offered; they are a demo record, nothing more

capabilities_required.name: cover-sensor
capabilities_required.purpose: to sense the magnet at all

non_goals: It is not a metal detector.
It does not use the sensor for sleep or wake.
